artifact.name: percentage_change_direction
artifact.content:
type Context = { [string]: any }

type Input = { initial_value: number, current_value: number }

type Output = { percentage_change: number, direction: string } | { error: string, message: string }

local function round2(n: number): number
	if n >= 0 then
		return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
	else
		return math.ceil(n * 100 - 0.5) / 100
	end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	local initial = input.initial_value
	local current = input.current_value

	if initial == 0 then
		return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must be non-zero to compute percentage change" }
	end

	local rawChange = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
	local pct = round2(rawChange)

	local dir: string
	if current > initial then
		dir = "up"
	elseif current < initial then
		dir = "down"
	else
		dir = "flat"
	end

	return { percentage_change = pct, direction = dir }
end
artifact.description: Compute percentage change between two numbers (rounded to 2 decimals) and return direction up/down/flat.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need the percent change from an initial value to a current value along with its direction.

artifact.name: notify_inactive_segment_customers
artifact.content:
local function makeText(name: string): string
	return string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", name)
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
	-- List customers in the segment
	local listResult = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
	-- Narrow on explicit ok == false to safely access error/message when it's an error variant
	if listResult.ok == false then
		return { error = listResult.error, message = listResult.message }
	end

	local customers = listResult.customers
	local notified: { string } = {}
	local failed: { string } = {}

	-- Respect hard cap: at most 10 sends (1 list + up to 10 send calls)
	local maxSends = 10
	local sends = 0

	for _, c in customers do
		if c.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
			if sends >= maxSends then
				break
			end
			local text = makeText(c.name)
			local sendResult = tools.message.send({ user = c.id, text = text })
			-- Narrow on explicit ok == false to safely access error/message when it's an error variant
			if sendResult.ok == false then
				table.insert(failed, c.id)
			else
				-- sendResult.ok == true
				table.insert(notified, c.id)
			end
			sends += 1
		end
	end

	return {
		notified = notified,
		failed = failed,
		count = #notified,
	}
end
artifact.description: List a segment's customers and message inactive ones with a friendly reminder.

    if input.initial_value == 0 then

    end

    local function round2(n: number): number
        if n >= 0 then
            return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
        else
            return -math.floor(math.abs(n) * 100 + 0.5) / 100
        end
    end

    local initial: number = input.initial_value
    local current: number = input.current_value

    local raw_change: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local pct: number = round2(raw_change)

    local direction: string
    if current > initial then
        direction = "up"
    elseif current < initial then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- Validate initial value
    if input.initial_value == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local initial: number = input.initial_value
    local current: number = input.current_value

    local raw_change: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100

    -- Round to 2 decimal places. Use a single rounding expression that
    -- produces the expected result for values near the .005 boundary.
    local rounded_change: number = math.floor(raw_change * 100 + 0.5) / 100

    local direction: string
    if rounded_change > 0 then
        direction = "up"
    elseif rounded_change < 0 then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
        -- ensure flat shows exact 0.0
        rounded_change = 0.0
    end

    return { percentage_change = rounded_change, direction = direction }
end
